facts.text: The Falcon Tuition Promise guarantees funding of all tuition and fees for eligible first-year Wisconsin students with a FAFSA total income of $62,000 or less and net worth of $300,000 or less.

sources.title: Falcon Tuition Promise | University of Wisconsin - River Falls
sources.quote: That's why we are now offering a Falcon Tuition Promise to support eligible first-year Wisconsin students to guarantee funding of all your tuition and fees after other grants, scholarship and aid have been applied.

sources.title: Falcon Tuition Promise | University of Wisconsin - River Falls
sources.quote: Have a Total Income on the FAFSA® of less than or equal to $62,000; Have a Net Worth on the FAFSA® of less than or equal to $300,000.
